research_question: What were national law school acceptance rates in 2025, and what did the completed 2026 cycle show about applicants and applications?

research_brief.purpose: Owner-approved statistics page for law school acceptance rates, rebuilt from the owner draft after a live fact-check.
research_brief.audience: Readers, students, journalists, and legal professionals in the United States who need sourced figures.
research_brief.data_period: AccessLex Data Deck spring 2026 (2025 cycle); LSAC September 2026 update (completed 2026 cycle); LSAC volume page as displayed 2026-11-10
research_brief.scope_limitations: No 2026 national admitted total is published in the LSAC cycle summary, so no 2026 rate is estimated. ABA Standard 509 specifics were cut because americanbar.org blocks automated readers and could not be verified.

sources.method: Opened and read the live page on 2026-11-10 (Claude fact-check); every figure used was matched to the page text; fact-check sign-off by Darlene Aberin.
sources.limitations: Administrative records; figures can be revised by the publisher. Not legal advice.

content_gaps: Ranking pages mix applicant and application denominators.
Few pages show the completed 2026 cycle totals beside the 2025 national rate.
Early-cycle figures are often presented as final.
value_add: Separates applicants from applications with a worked ratio, reconciles AccessLex and LSAC counts with labeled arithmetic, and gives a five-measure school comparison framework.
